content: Hi, how are you? I'm starting to learn Lean and I was very happy to discover this community. I look forward to meeting you all and contributing. I'm developing some projects. When I have more ready to show you, I'd love to share them with you.
Actually, while I'm at it... I'm building a best-first proof agent with retrieval and verifier-in-the-loop; what projects/papers/repos do you recommend as references, and what pitfalls have you seen?
